literal: Let not praise at any time oneself; let not desire good not yielding action.
translation: Never praise yourself at any time, and never desire to do deeds that yield no good.
modern: எந்தக் காலத்திலும் தன்னைத் தானே புகழ்ந்து கொள்ளக் கூடாது; நன்மை தராத செயல்களைச் செய்ய விரும்பவும் கூடாது.
explanation: This couplet advises against two major faults: self-praise and engaging in useless deeds. The word 'வியவற்க' means 'do not marvel at or praise', warning a person never to boast about themselves ('தன்னை') at any time ('எஞ்ஞான்றும்'). Furthermore, 'நயவற்க' means 'do not desire', instructing them to avoid any action ('வினை') that does not yield ('பயவா') a good outcome ('நன்றி'). By avoiding arrogance and fruitless actions, one maintains clear judgment and effectiveness.
